plan.notes: Source: https://acu.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Psychology-BS.pdf (official ACU Online degree plan, 2026-2027 Academic Year, College of Leadership and Professional Studies, 100% ONLINE, 120 credit hours). Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30. Caveats: (1) PSYO 120 (Introduction to Psychology) is marked '*Also used to fulfill University Requirement' and BIOL 101 (Biology - Human Perspective) is marked '*Also used to fulfill University Requirement'; both are modeled as gen-ed slots, not major courses. (2) The PDF lists 7 'Psychology Selections' ('Courses may include:'); all 7 are modeled as major courses (21 hrs) so the plan sums to 120: 30 (10 requirements excl. PSYO 120) + 21 (selections) + 13 electives + 56 gen-ed = 120. (3) PSYO 493 is 'a capstone and writing-intensive course' (placed in Year 4). (4) Semester placement is a recommended sequence; the PDF does not publish a semester-by-semester layout. No course prerequisites are stated in the PDF.
